# Claude Agent SDK source verification

The agent receives web and news search as an in-process SDK MCP server and uses
them to turn a broad public claim into a verification memo.

SerpApi enhancement: the SDK's custom-tool pattern now searches live evidence
and distinguishes confirmed facts, overstatements, and jurisdictional gaps.

```bash
uv run --with . --with claude-agent-sdk cookbook/claude-agent-sdk/main.py
```

Read the
[complete cookbook entry](https://github.com/serpapi/serpapi-search-tools-python/tree/main/cookbook/claude-agent-sdk)
or Anthropic's official
[SDK MCP tool example](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python#custom-tools-as-in-process-sdk-mcp-servers).
